results.title: Biometric unlock material is protected by the Keychain access control (Touch ID enforced by the OS, not by a UI prompt)
results.evidence: biometric items: data-protection keychain + SecAccessControl(BiometryCurrentSet, WhenPasscodeSetThisDeviceOnly); no LAContext evaluatePolicy gate in code (the Keychain itself refuses reads without a fresh Touch ID match; re-enrolled fingers invalidate the item). The item holds a random device key that wraps the user key (wrapUserKeyForDevice).
